scores.tell: Muted grey-purple floor and desaturated grey-pink wall stripes; the dark cauldron is nearly neutral. The green potion is loud, so the palette feels a bit dull and cool against real cards' saturated backgrounds.
Palette is natural, but the whole scene is green with muted grey stone. The saturated greens are plausible, but the neutral share is higher than on real cards, and the stone is dull lilac-grey.
Navy-grey locomotive body is desaturated and cool, with muted dusty orange desert. The red wheels and bumper are the only accent. Slightly gritty and realistic, with less candy chroma.
Same palette as c106 but with a slightly pinker stone. Still muted grey-lilac objects on a green field, with less chroma on the hero than on real cards.
None significant. The yellow background with orange rings, grey saucer, green dome and purple underside are clean saturated hue roles, in line with real cards. The grey metal is a touch neutral.
The navy body with cyan keys on a yellow-orange pi pattern gives a clear complementary hue role. Chroma is high and shadows stay in the same hue family. The grey screen is the only small neutral.
The purple tower, blue sky and green hill are saturated and varied. The house body is a muted grey-mauve, and the many hue families (purple, blue, green, orange, yellow) make it slightly busy.
Orange rim on striped green is a clean complementary pairing with a navy accent and a red second hand. Chroma is rich and shadows stay related. Real cards use similar pairings.
Nearly identical to c131, with a slightly lighter lime stripe and hot orange. The palette is natural and matches the real cards.

The near-black charcoal cat is almost neutral with a slight warm cast. It sits on loud orange and yellow, so the contrast is heavy and the cat has no hue shading. Real cards keep more color in dark subjects.
